info.name: Fondeka Business API v1 — Sandbox
info.description: Generated from the merchant contract. Set apiKey locally, businessId and a unique intent. Keep intent on retries. Async payments need polling; running the collection once does not wait for completion. Synthetic fixtures only.

exec: const key=pm.variables.get("apiKey") || "";

if (!["fdk_sandbox_", "fdk_biz_sandbox_", "fdk_biz_test_"].some(prefix => key.startsWith(prefix))) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error("This example collection accepts sandbox keys only."); }

if (!pm.variables.get("intent") || pm.variables.get("intent")==="CHANGE_ME_ONCE_PER_LOGICAL_RUN") { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error("Set intent to a unique value; keep it unchanged on retries."); }

request.description: List this Business's bill payments. Uses the authenticated Business and credential environment; responses are not cached.

item.name: List endpoint error codes and sandbox simulations

request.description: Read endpoint-specific HTTP request errors and supported asynchronous payment outcomes. The authenticated key determines the environment. X-Simulate-Error-Code selects an immediate request rejection, a deferred payment failure, or a crypto confirmation hold that remains PROCESSING without a terminal webhook. Check resultingStatus, paymentMethodTypes and the operation before selecting a scenario. Real authentication, ownership and access checks run first. LIVE keys ignore the header. This read submits no payment and calls no provider.
